verdict.rationale: Secureframe's official MCP server exposes controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks and more as tools. Any MCP-capable client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor) can then look things up and take actions in natural language, using OAuth-based sign-in. However, natural-language operation depends on an external third-party assistant, and the Comply AI features are task-specific generators rather than a command interface. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language assistant, documented scope of which write actions are available via MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
